title: Aalavanthan
desc: Nandu and Vijay, brothers with a traumatic past, struggle with memories of abuse. Driven by his delusions, Nandu plans to kill Vijay's fiancée, mistaking her for his abusive stepmother.

title: Machakkaran
desc: Vicky often gets into trouble due to bad luck. Things change when he meets and falls in love with Shivani, the daughter of a rich businessman.

title: Uyirile Kalandhathu
desc: Suriya, a medical student, navigates love and family tensions. His relationship with Priya faces opposition from an unexpected source, leading to dramatic twists in his life.

title: Business Man
desc: An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.

title: Kadhal Sugamanathu
desc: A reserved young woman develops unspoken feelings for her friend's brother. However, crushed by her envious sister's deception, she abandons hope and resigns to an arranged marriage.
